dreamteamer.title: Routines
dreamteamer.description: `routines`: commitments that recur — a renewal, a filing, a weekly sweep — each an RFC 5545 RRULE, the anchor it counts from, and the next date it is owed. The `working-with-routines` skill writes and reads the rule; its script renders it in English and rolls `next_due` forward when a date has passed.
